summary: The proposed patch addresses the issue by using `request.path` instead of `request.path_info`, which should include the script name. However, it may introduce behavioral changes if `path_info` was intended to exclude the script name.

issues.description: Changing from `request.path_info` to `request.path` could alter the behavior of `get_full_path_info` in ways that were not anticipated, potentially breaking existing setups that rely on `path_info` excluding the script name.
